description: Measured ECD sign anchors recovered from the green experimental curve in Figure 4. These are experimental comparison inputs, not computed target values. The plotted ordinate is circular dichroism in mdeg; no absolute-amplitude comparison is specified.
comparison_scope: Compare every anchor and the broad pattern, retaining disagreements. The 255 and 270 nm features are weak and close to the plotted zero baseline; their graphical signs are not exact high-confidence experimental discriminants.

anchors.reliability: weak near-zero feature; digitization and experimental baseline uncertainty unavailable
